dedupe_keys.name: nhs style hospital admissions kpi preparation toolkit

description: The nhs-admissions-stats toolkit compiles YAML definitions for emergency-admission rate, length of stay, readmissions, an occupancy proxy and weekend share into DuckDB SQL. It also provides provider-comparison plots, reporting code, a command-line interface and a seeded synthetic 156-week validation dataset with injected changes and outliers. The repository gives setup commands, test reports and a public MIT licence with no charge. Coverage is NHS-style input schemas, not a specific live NHS release; the synthetic benchmark spans 156 simulated weeks, and geographic provider identities are not real-world observations. A limitation is that passing the repository’s known-answer tests does not establish validity on hospital operational data; no code was run in this review. Simulation use includes preparing consistent demand and utilisation indicators before calibration. It complements data-cms-provider-data-hospitals with a reusable measurement tool, not new source counts. The generated dataset and results were not opened.
name: NHS-style hospital admissions KPI preparation toolkit
notes: G8; G8-0635. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.  Cited as: nhs-admissions-stats repository documentation. Synthetic validation cases; no live NHS dataset is claimed..
